owner_calls.question: Two entries pinned to Washington, D.C. are placed by sources just outside the city in Virginia: X-Men: First Class 'CIA' (the CIA meeting with Director McCone, at CIA Headquarters in Langley, Virginia) and the 'Magneto's plastic prison' entries for X-Men (2000) and X2 (fan wiki gives Arlington County, Virginia). Neither location is clearly stated on screen. Keep them under Washington, D.C. as the metro area, or move them to a Virginia pin?
options: Move the CIA entry to a new Langley, Virginia pin
Move both the CIA and plastic prison entries to Virginia pins
owner_calls.evidence: xmenmovies wiki: CIA Headquarters is in Langley, Virginia, where Moira brings Charles and Raven in 1962 to convince McCone; Plastic Prison location field is Arlington County, Virginia (no on-screen citation). Wikipedia's First Class plot only says 'takes him and Raven to the CIA'.
